description_en: Retrieves details for a Global Database Network (GDN)
description_zh: 查询全球数据库网络（GDN）详情
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-global-database-network --gdn-id gdn-bp1fttxsrmv00000 --resource-group-id rg-000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeGlobalDatabaseNetwork

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Global Database Network (GDN)
parameters.name: gdn_id

Port.description_en: The port number of the connection string

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the GDN was created

Category.description_en:
The edition of the cluster. Valid values:

`Normal`: Cluster Edition `Basic`: Single-node Edition `Archive`: X-Engine Edition `NormalMultimaster`: Multi-master Cluster Edition `SENormal`: Standard Edition

Single-node Edition is not supported for PolarDB for PostgreSQL clusters that run PostgreSQL 11.

Standard Edition is supported for PolarDB for MySQL clusters that run MySQL 8.0 or 5.7 and for PolarDB for PostgreSQL clusters that run PostgreSQL 14.

X-Engine Edition and Multi-master Cluster Edition are supported only for PolarDB for MySQL clusters that run MySQL 8.0
Category.description_zh:
产品系列，取值范围如下：

Normal：集群版
Basic：单节点
Archive：高压缩引擎（X-Engine）
NormalMultimaster：多主架构集群版
SENormal：标准版

PolarDB PostgreSQL 版 PostgreSQL 11 版本不支持单节点。
PolarDB MySQL 版 8.0 版本、5.7 版本，PolarDB PostgreSQL 版 PostgreSQL 14 版本支持标准版。
PolarDB MySQL 版 8.0 版本，支持高压缩引擎（X-Engine）和多主架构集群版

DBClusterStatus.description_en: The status of the cluster. For more information, see [Cluster statuses]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99286.html）
DBClusterStatus.description_zh: GDN中的集群状态。具体请参见[集群状态表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99286.html）

DBNodes.description_en: The details of the nodes in the cluster
DBNodes.description_zh: 数据库节点的信息详情

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the node was created
CreationTime.description_zh: 数据库节点的创建时间

DBNodeRole.description_en:
The role of the node. Valid values:

Writer: the primary node

Reader: a read-only node
DBNodeRole.description_zh:
数据库节点的角色。取值：

Writer：主节点

Reader：只读节点

DBNodeStatus.description_en:
The status of the node. Valid values:

Creating: The node is being created.

Running: The node is running.

Deleting: The node is being deleted.

Rebooting: The node is being restarted.

ClassChanging: The node type is being changed.

NetAddressCreating: A network connection is being created.

NetAddressDeleting: A network connection is being deleted.

NetAddressModifying: A network connection is being modified.

MinorVersionUpgrading: The minor version is being upgraded.

Maintaining: The cluster is being maintained.

Switching: A failover is in progress
DBNodeStatus.description_zh:
节点状态。取值：

Creating：创建中

Running：运行中

Deleting：删除中

Rebooting：重启中

ClassChanging：正在变更节点规格

NetAddressCreating：正在创建网络连接

NetAddressDeleting：正在删除网络连接

NetAddressModifying：正在修改网络连接

MinorVersionUpgrading：小版本升级中

Maintaining：集群维护中

Switching：切换中

FailoverPriority.description_en: The failover priority. In the event of a failover, the system promotes a read-only node to the primary node. A larger value indicates a higher priority. Each read-only node is assigned a failover priority. Valid values: 1 to 15
FailoverPriority.description_zh: Failover优先级。每个节点都有一个Failover优先级，决定了当故障切换时，该节点被选举为主节点的概率高低。数值越大，优先级越高，取值范围为1~15

MaxConnections.description_en: The maximum number of concurrent connections
MaxConnections.description_zh: 集群最大的并发连接数

MaxIOPS.description_en: The maximum I/O operations per second (IOPS)

DBType.description_en: The database engine. Only MySQL is supported
DBType.description_zh: 数据库引擎类型。当前仅支持MySQL类型

DBVersion.description_en: The database engine version. Only version 8.0 is supported
DBVersion.description_zh: 数据库引擎版本。当前仅支持8.0版本

ExpireTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the cluster.

This parameter is returned only for subscription clusters. An empty string is returned for pay-as-you-go clusters
ExpireTime.description_zh:
集群到期时间。

仅付费方式为Prepaid（包年包月）的集群会返回具体参数值，Postpaid（按量付费）集群则返回空值

Expired.description_en:
Indicates whether the cluster has expired. Valid values:

true: The cluster has expired.

false: The cluster has not expired.

This parameter is returned only for subscription clusters
Expired.description_zh:
集群是否到期。

true：是

false：否

仅付费方式为Prepaid（包年包月）的集群支持返回该参数

PayType.description_en:
The billing method of the cluster. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.

Prepaid: subscription
PayType.description_zh:
付费类型：

Postpaid：按量付费。

Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the cluster

ReplicaLag.description_en: The replication lag for cross-region replication between the primary and standby clusters. Unit: seconds
ReplicaLag.description_zh: 主从集群间跨地域的复制延迟时间。单位为秒

Role.description_en:
The role of the cluster in the GDN. Valid values:

primary: the primary cluster

standby: a standby cluster

A GDN consists of one primary cluster and up to four standby clusters
Role.description_zh:
集群角色。取值：

primary：主集群

standby：从集群

一个GDN中包含一个主集群和最多四个从集群

ServerlessType.description_en:
The type of the Serverless cluster. The value is fixed as `AgileServerless`.

This parameter is returned only for Serverless clusters
ServerlessType.description_zh:
Serverless类型。当前取值固定为AgileServerless（敏态）。
仅Serverless集群支持该参数

StorageUsed.description_en: The amount of storage space used. Unit: bytes
StorageUsed.description_zh: 存储空间的使用量，单位为Byte

DBType.description_en: The database engine type. Only MySQL is supported
DBType.description_zh: 数据库引擎类型。当前仅支持MySQL类型

DBVersion.description_en: The database engine version. Only version 8.0 is supported
DBVersion.description_zh: 数据库引擎版本。当前仅支持8.0版本

GDNDescription.description_en:
The description of the GDN. It must meet the following requirements:

It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

It must start with a letter or a Chinese character.

It can contain only letters, Chinese characters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

It must be 2 to 126 characters in length
GDNDescription.description_zh:
GDN备注描述。要求如下：

不能以http://或https://开头。

必须以大小写字母或中文开头。

可以包含大小写字母、中文、数字、下划线（_）或连字符（-）。

长度为2~126个字符

GDNStatus.description_en:
The status of the Global Database Network (GDN). Valid values:

creating: The GDN is being created.

active: The GDN is running.

deleting: The GDN is being deleted.

locked: The GDN is locked. In this state, you cannot perform any operations on any cluster in the GDN.

removing_member: A cluster is being removed from the GDN
GDNStatus.description_zh:
GDN的状态。取值：

creating：创建中

active：运行中

deleting：删除中

locked：锁定中（此时无法对GDN下的任一集群执行任何操作）

removing_member：从集群正在脱离GDN
